sentences: It is said that the day we stop learning is the day we die.
I strongly believe that every individual should strive everyday to improve and grow as a person.
We should always try to learn something new because it challenges us and helps us to grow intellectually.
Many scientific studies suggest that learning a new language or a musical instrument are highly beneficial for our brain.
These two skills make new connections in our brain and keep our brain young and sharp.
I always wanted to learn Spanish and after reading this research I got all the more motivated for it.
I live in a community where quite a few people speak Spanish, hence I got an early exposure to the language.
But it was not until my higher secondary I started giving a serious thought about learning this language.
After which I joined a professional language school to master my Spanish language skills.
Initially I thought that it would be easy given my early exposure to the language.
But soon I realized that learning a foreign language is no piece of cake.
Getting the grammar and pronunciation right, is particularly difficult.
It took me around three months to learn the basic rules of grammar.
And I still cannot get some words right out of my mouth, which I know when I see the funny reactions of my Spanish neighbours when I try to converse in their native language.
I also regularly see youtube videos on Spanish lessons and these have helped me immensely.
I would say learning a new language has not been easy and it certainly takes its time, but the overall experience has been exciting and enriching.
And after learning Spanish I intend to try my hands at German.
